templates.name: gk_welcome
templates.title: Welcome / signup thank-you
templates.trigger: Customer creates an account on the website.
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, thank you for creating your Graha Kavach account. Your account is ready. You can now track your orders, save your delivery address and check out faster. If you need any help, just reply to this message.

templates.name: gk_cart_reminder_1
templates.title: Abandoned cart - reminder 1
templates.trigger: About 1 hour after the customer entered their mobile number at checkout and did not complete the order.
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, you left {{2}} in your cart. Complete your order today to keep your home and family protected from fire hazards. Your items are saved and waiting for you.

templates.name: gk_cart_reminder_2
templates.title: Abandoned cart - reminder 2
templates.trigger: About 24 hours after the cart was last updated, if the customer has not ordered and did not open the first reminder link.
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, your cart with {{2}} is still saved for you. Have a question about the product, delivery or payment? Reply to this message and our team will be happy to help you.

templates.name: gk_payment_success
templates.title: Payment successful (online / prepaid)
templates.trigger: Online payment for an order is confirmed.
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, we have received your payment of Rs. {{2}} for order #{{3}}. Thank you for choosing Graha Kavach. We will keep you updated at every step of your order.

templates.name: gk_cod_advance_received
templates.title: COD order confirmed (advance received)
templates.trigger: Cash on Delivery order where the online advance has been paid.
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, your Cash on Delivery order #{{2}} is confirmed. We have received your advance payment of Rs. {{3}}. The remaining Rs. {{4}} is payable at the time of delivery.

templates.name: gk_order_processing
templates.title: Order is being processed
templates.trigger: A few minutes after the order is confirmed (delay is configurable). For COD orders without an advance it is sent immediately.
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, your order #{{2}} is now being processed. Our team is checking and packing your items with care. We will notify you as soon as it is shipped.

templates.name: gk_order_shipped
templates.title: Order shipped with tracking
templates.trigger: A tracking number is added to the order (Advanced Shipment Tracking).
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, good news. Your order #{{2}} has been shipped via {{3}}. Tracking number: {{4}}. Expected delivery: {{5}}.

templates.name: gk_order_delivered
templates.title: Order delivered
templates.trigger: Order status is changed to Completed.
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, your order #{{2}} has been delivered. We hope you are happy with your Graha Kavach purchase. If you face any issue with the product, simply reply to this message and we will help you right away.

templates.name: gk_order_cancelled
templates.title: Order cancelled
templates.trigger: A confirmed order is cancelled. Unpaid orders that expire automatically do not trigger this message.
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, your order #{{2}} has been cancelled. If you had paid online, the refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5 to 7 working days. For any questions, reply to this message.

templates.name: gk_order_refunded
templates.title: Refund initiated
templates.trigger: A refund is created on the order.
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, a refund of Rs. {{2}} for order #{{3}} has been initiated to your original payment method. It may take 5 to 7 working days to reflect in your account.

templates.name: gk_payment_failed
templates.title: Payment failed
templates.trigger: Order status is changed to Failed.
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, the payment for your order #{{2}} could not be completed. If any amount was debited from your account, it will be refunded automatically within 5 to 7 working days. You can place the order again anytime from our website.

templates.name: gk_admin_new_order
templates.title: New order alert (store owner)
templates.trigger: A new confirmed order arrives. Sent to the admin number set in the plugin settings.
templates.body: New order #{{1}} received from {{2}}, mobile {{3}}. Order value: Rs. {{4}}. Payment: {{5}}. Please review it in the WooCommerce dashboard.
